title: Nyx trajectory export: preserving reference-frame meaning
claim: Accepted trajectory exports must preserve the reference-frame identity of every selected row, or explicitly reject selections not representable by the one-frame-per-table format.
mechanism: The old exporter chose the frame of the source trajectory's first state. This could disagree with a selected row, while the importer reused one parsed frame for recovered states. The accepted patch derives the frame from selected rows and rejects a mixed-frame selection.

historical_native.qualification_scope: Finite test suite; selected export/import files unchanged before targeted repair; neither whole-project nor flight-system assurance.

fresh_check.reason: Rust/cargo are absent in this workspace
fresh_check.patch_identity: Historical repair script output matches accepted exporter bytes exactly
